entries.label: Crack
entries.description: A visible fracture in a rigid surface (e.g. glass, screen, casing, or frame), ranging from a hairline mark to full structural separation. Consolidates what earlier placeholder data split into 19 phone-screen-specific subtypes (hairline, corner, edge, spider-web, shattered-screen, LCD/OLED internal, back-glass, camera-lens, frame, and screen-separation cracks) — those distinctions can still be captured in visible_evidence and reviewer notes, but are not separate routing categories.
entries.notes: Policy override: tool-rules.ts ALWAYS_HIGH_SEVERITY_DEFECTS forces every 'crack' hypothesis to high severity regardless of default_severity or severity_rules above, since any crack is treated as functionality/structural risk. sop-register.md should be updated to match this generic scope — it currently still describes a smartphone-only, 20-category crack taxonomy left over from the earlier placeholder.
